title: System Functions
description: The system shall provide the following functions: user login, lecture upload, file to text conversion, text extraction module, question generator, question bank, difficulty level selection.

title: Detailed Functional Specification
description: The system shall have the following detailed functional specifications: user authentication, lecture upload and processing, question generation, question bank management, difficulty level selection, and user interface.

title: User Login
description: The system shall allow users to log in with their credentials and access the system's features.

title: Lecture Upload
description: The system shall allow users to upload lectures in various formats and process them for question generation.

title: File to Text Conversion
description: The system shall convert uploaded files to text format for question generation.

title: Text Extraction Module
description: The system shall extract relevant text from uploaded files for question generation.

title: Question Generator
description: The system shall generate questions based on the extracted text and user input.

title: Question Bank
description: The system shall store and manage generated questions for future use.

title: Difficulty Level Selection
description: The system shall allow users to select the difficulty level of generated questions.
